messages:
Cara (CS): Heads-up: SemaphoreAI wants an IPv6 allowlist + embeddings throughput bump for a pilot with a partner tomorrow. Onboarding health score is 62, renewal in ~29 days. They think strong perf in the pilot will move the renewal. Can SRE pin eu-west-1, allow IPv6 2001:db8::/48 for 24h, and bump embeddings throughput to 12k/min with burst 20k? Customer ID: SA-8812.

Leo (Acct Exec): They specifically called out embeddings latency for search relevance. If we keep p95 < 40ms for embeddings it helps the renewal negotiation. I'll join the demo.

Jaya (SRE): IPv6 is fine; need confirmation they will use mTLS or token header. Also prefer we add a short token rotation rule (30m) because partner only gave ephemeral certs. Canary 8m before full apply?

Cara (CS): They will provide both client certs and header X-SA-Token. Token rotation: partner will rotate every 30m; they asked we accept the whole /48 for the window. Window: 2026-08-10T09:00:00Z -> 2026-08-11T09:00:00Z (24h). Embeddings target 12000/min, burst 20000. Ask for minimal telemetry (embedding timing only) and audit log for rule apply/revoke.

Amin (Solutions): Recommend prefilling embedding cache & pre-computing common vectors 2h before start. I will upload a warmup script and short prompt-set that hits the semantic search workload. Also suggest collecting p50/p95/p99 for embedding time.

Jaya (SRE): I'll do 8m canary in eu-west-1 with auto-revoke. Rollback if embedding p95 > 80ms or error rate > 1% during canary. Draft config I'll apply below.

Jaya (SRE): ```json
{
  "customer_id":"SA-8812",
  "region_pin":"eu-west-1",
  "allowlist":["2001:db8::/48"],
  "auth":{"mTLS":"required","header":"X-SA-Token","token_rotation_mins":30},
  "embeddings_limits":{"per_min":12000,"burst":20000},
  "telemetry":"embeddings_timing_only",
  "audit_log":true,
  "start":"2026-08-10T09:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-08-11T09:00:00Z",
  "notes":"24h IPv6 embeddings pilot; auto-revoke; prefill embeddings cache 2h prior"
}
```

infra-bot: Ticket CS-7799 created. Canary scheduled at 6321122400. Requestor: Jaya.

Jaya (SRE): Canary started at 6321122410. Quick smoke: embedding p95 36ms, errors 0.2%. mTLS handshakes successful.

Jaya (SRE): Canary healthy  rolling to full apply for SA-8812 in eu-west-1. Full apply complete at 6321122550.

Cara (CS): Thanks team :tada: I'll notify SemaphoreAI with the window, cert rotation note, and reminders about TLS and header. Leo  can you prepare a renewal playbook tying p95 < 40ms and <0.5% errors for 24h to a preferred renewal rate? Amin  please share warmup artifacts and the link to the vector prefill job.

Leo (Acct Exec): Will draft conditional renewal language. Suggest 12-month preferred pricing if post-pilot embeddings p95 < 40ms and errors < 0.5% for 24h.

Amin (Solutions): Warmup script and prefill job uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/SA-8812 and scheduled 2h before start. Link: https://internal.storage/warmups/SA-8812

Cara (CS): Closing loop. Auto-revoke in 24h and we'll attach telemetry summary to the account. Noting account health improvement trigger for renewal outreach.
